heroTitle: May the Light of Christmas Illuminate Your Path
heroBody: We celebrate another cycle of achievements, lessons, and true connections. May tonight renew hope, strengthen bonds with those you love, and bring peace, health, and inspiration for every day of the new year.

pillars.peaceDesc: Genuine moments around the table with family and friends.
pillars.gratitudeDesc: Appreciation for every challenge overcome throughout the year.
pillars.dreamsDesc: Courage and renewed energy to turn projects into reality.
